notes: Offset the fast way: select a line, press O, move the mouse to the side, click or type the distance and Enter; Enter again makes the next one. Images and PDF plans: drop them on the drawing - a world file, GeoTIFF or GeoPDF lands in place by itself, anything else is aligned by clicking a point on the image and where it really is (snaps to survey points). Placed images now come back when a job reopens. Scan > Clean: noise filter, thin evenly, density map.
